title: Trick-or-Treat: Adversarial Evaluation of Multimodal Medical Reasoning with Synthetic Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.06631v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We used medical image synthesis to create a challenging multimodal evaluation framework that exposes hallucination behaviors in frontier models. Evaluating multimodal reasoning has historically been difficult because existing medical datasets rarely pair different image modalities, such as radiographs and external clinical photographs. To address this gap, we introduce Trick-or-Treat, an adversarial multimodal medical benchmark that pairs real chest radiographs with synthetic clinical photographs to challenge models' cross-modal reasoning. For each of a wide range of conditions, we created two pairs of images, where the pairs share a single chest radiograph but contain different external photographs. In matched pairs, the chest radiograph and photograph both contain findings suggesting the same disease (e.g., varicella pneumonia suggested by lung opacities and crusted skin lesions seen in chickenpox). translated_title: “不给糖就捣蛋”：使用合成图像对多模态医学推理进行对抗性评估
translated_abstract: 我们利用医学图像合成技术创建了一个具有挑战性的多模态评估框架，用以揭示前沿模型中的幻觉行为。评估多模态推理历来十分困难，因为现有的医学数据集很少将不同的图像模态配对，例如放射影像与外部临床照片。为了弥补这一空白，我们推出了 Trick-or-Treat，这是一个对抗性的多模态医学基准，它将真实的胸部X光片与合成的临床照片配对，以挑战模型的跨模态推理能力。针对广泛的疾病类别，我们创建了两对图像，每对图像共享同一张胸部X光片，但包含不同的外部照片。在匹配对中，胸部X光片和照片都包含提示同一疾病的发现（例如，肺部阴影和在水痘中可见的结痂皮肤病变共同提示水痘肺炎）。在不匹配对中，照片……
tldr: 该论文提出Trick-or-Treat基准，通过将真实胸部X光片与合成的临床照片配对构成对抗性多模态评测框架，有效暴露了前沿模型在跨模态医学推理中的幻觉行为。
